Alex C.: heads-up — saw a 150ms p95 spike on the canary around 09:12. quick skim of the pick trace shows a lot of requests with seqlen ~480–540 choosing the fallback 'cpu_generic_v1' instead of the arch-optimized path.
Maria T.: ugh, any telemetry lines you can paste?
Alex C.: pasted a 10-line sample from the picktrace log:
```
[PICK] ts=1769549952 req_id=abc123 kernel=cpu_generic_v1 arch=arm64 seqlen_bucket=512 reason=fallback_no_vec_gemm flags=0x4 sample_rate=0.001
[PICK] ts=1769549953 req_id=abc124 kernel=gpu_fast_gemm arch=ampere seqlen_bucket=128 reason=matched_profile flags=0x1 sample_rate=0.001
[PICK] ts=1769549954 req_id=abc125 kernel=cpu_generic_v1 arch=arm64 seqlen_bucket=512 reason=kv_cache_miss flags=0x4 sample_rate=0.001
[PICK] ts=1769549955 req_id=abc126 kernel=cpu_generic_v1 arch=arm64 seqlen_bucket=512 reason=autotune_disabled flags=0x0 sample_rate=0.001
```
Alex C.: the important bits are reason and seqlen_bucket — looks like the autotuner decided not to select the vectorized gemm for these seqs (reasons vary: kv_cache_miss and fallback_no_vec_gemm).
Jon Chen: can you grep for ENV debug flags? i want to confirm if the canary had RUNTIME_PICK_DEBUG enabled by mistake.
Alex C.: ran this on the pod: `kubectl exec -c runtime $POD -- printenv | egrep "RUNTIME_PICK|BATCH_TRACE|KV_"` output: `RUNTIME_PICK_DEBUG=0
RUNTIME_PICK_SAMPLE_RATE=0.001
BATCH_TRACE=0
KV_PREFIX_CACHE_SIZE=1024`
Samir K.: if KV_PREFIX_CACHE_SIZE is 1024 we could be thrashing for long-prefix sessions — that would produce kv_cache_miss reasons and push requests to non-vectorized paths. did we change the cache policy in the canary?
Alex C.: not intentionally. deploy-bot shows the canary config used the default cache policy. but the workload on the canary included a subset of long conversations (customer X) which may have changed the prefix distribution.
PerfBot: Canary 1769549800 rolled with config ref=canary/seqopt-2 — perf collection starting.
Maria T.: can we repro locally with synthetic load? maybe run the small harness with seqlen distribution tuned to 450–600.
Jon Chen: plan: 1) repro in local harness with seqlen dist (450–600) + kv miss pattern, 2) enable `RUNTIME_PICK_DEBUG=1` and `BATCH_TRACE=1` for 2k requests, 3) collect picktrace + perf counters (L1/L2/vec usage), 4) upload logs to s3://perf-redwood/inc-4312/picktrace/1769549999/
Alex C.: i'll run step 1 & 2 now. command i used: `./perf_harness --workers 8 --qps 200 --seqlen-dist "450:0.6,512:0.3,600:0.1" --kv-hitrate 0.6 --emit-picktrace /tmp/picks.json`
Samir K.: also add `--force-autotune=on` to compare autotuned kernel picks vs current.
Alex C.: good idea — will run both variants and diff picks.
Maria T.: small ask — if you see `reason=autotune_disabled` in the trace, that's likely from the runtime flag guard (we added a kill-switch for the last rollout). toggle is `AUTOTUNE_ENABLED=true` in the configmap.
Alex C.: noted — checking canary configmap now.
DeployBot: deploy status: canary/seqopt-2 -> healthy (3/3) :white_check_mark:
Alex C.: quick status update: local reproducer shows the same pattern when kv hit rate < 0.7. enabling autotune flips ~72% of those picks to `vector_gemm_arm64_v2` and p95 drops ~110ms. uploading logs to s3://perf-redwood/inc-4312/picktrace/1769549999/put.log
Jon Chen: great — next steps: (A) enable AUTOTUNE in canary for 1 hour, (B) increase RUNTIME_PICK_SAMPLE_RATE to 0.01 to get more traces, (C) dashboard alert for seqlen_bucket=512 fallback rate > 2%
Alex C.: opening INC-4312 and attaching the local reproducer + logs. i'll also post a short summary in #eng-runtime before the perf sync. :eyes:
Maria T.: thanks — i'll own the canary toggle if you want.
Alex C.: appreciate it. will follow up in 1h with perf numbers.
